rss: Petrol and diesel prices hit highest since 2022
title: Fuel Prices Zoom Upward!
story: The cost of filling up cars is going up! This means it might cost more to drive around town.
storyBig: Fuel prices have surged to their highest levels since 2022, impacting transportation costs and potentially leading to higher prices for goods delivered by truck.
think: Why would higher fuel prices affect the price of your toys?
bull: Higher prices might encourage new inventions for cars.
bear: It could cost more to deliver pizzas to your home.

rss: Rent rises set to speed up in gloomy forecast for tenants
title: Rents Climb Higher!
story: The cost of renting homes is going up. People may have to pay more to live in their homes.
storyBig: Rent prices are predicted to increase by 4% to 5% annually, putting financial pressure on tenants as housing costs rise.
think: How might higher rents affect families' spending on fun activities?
bull: This might encourage more people to build treehouses!
bear: Families might have less money for board games and ice cream.
